{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Number of patients after deduplication
num_patients = len(df_dedup)

# Now check assay_batch: batch B values are in µg/L, not ng/mL. Need to divide by 10
# Batch A: ng/mL (correct)
# Batch B: µg/L → convert to ng/mL by dividing by 10

df_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final']
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_ngml'] = df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] / 10

# Compute the mean of biomarker_final in ng/mL
mean_biomarker_final_ngml = df_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'].mean()

# Print each number that will be in the evidence
print(num_patients)
print(mean_biomarker_final_ngml)"}
